release_notes: Fix optional room player limits: save a known maximum while leaving minimum unknown, or vice versa. Partial ranges retain the known bound and confirm only the current group size; changed groups need renewed approval. Known limits, ownership, platform rules and vetoes remain enforced. Includes updated player instructions and troubleshooting. Same seven capabilities, manual updates; requires host Plugin API v1.1.12 and Discord Bot Notifications >=0.1.2.
